plugins.microphonePermission: COOPR listens while you hold Ask, or while hands-free is on. On this iPhone, speech is turned into text on the device and the audio is not kept.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: COOPR turns your question into text on this iPhone. The audio is not kept.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: COOPR uses your location while the app is open to show your distance to the green. Your position is not saved as a shot.

plugins.photosPermission: COOPR reads a photo you choose. A bag photo stays on this phone. Add from photos sends that picture to the COOPR extract server, only to read the club details, when a server is set.
plugins.cameraPermission: COOPR uses the camera for a club or a scorecard. A bag photo stays on this phone. A scorecard photo is sent to the COOPR extract server, only to read the club details, when a server is set.
